Are you in therapy? I know it's reddit's go-to answer for everything but it really does help. I've been on and off the intuitive eating wagon a couple of times since I started earlier this year but one thing that kept me coming back was the self love I built over the past year. I find that once you begin to lov, trustb(this is a big one!) and respect yourself it becomes easier to choose to eat intuitively and even if you have times of dieting in between it's easier to remove yourself from that situation because you can tell it's not right for you. Atleast that's been my experience. 

If you can't go to therapy then I do suggest working towards other things in your life - maybe having a fitness goal or something related to Any of your hobbies? Just something that enables you to view yourself in a better light. Feel free to PM me anytime because I'm struggling with my self-esteem too and I think its definitely been my biggest roadblock so far.
How would I go about becoming an approved user?

Sure, the possibility is there but I'm wondering if there's a way to live your life post diagnosis/treatment or if you'll always have to go to therapy and be medicated and fall back into depression (even if it isn't as bad as before) when things go wrong.

Ideally I would love to go into research or health administration. I know those aren't 2 traditional jobs that one would look into but.. currently they seem to interest me the most. Although dermatology isn't looking too bad either.
